verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents two places your data can live: its own EU cloud, or self-hosted 'entirely inside your own network' on your own infrastructure. Self-hosting gives full control over location, but the evidence shows only one cloud region (EU) and no documented region picker or residency guarantees for the hosted service. Missing for 10: a documented choice among multiple cloud regions, explicit data-residency commitments or docs, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: On our EU cloud, or entirely inside your own network.
run it on your own infrastructure, and keep the governance your company needs.
Free on every plan, cloud or self-hosted.
